title: Budget Friendly Decorating
text: Budget Friendly Decorating. This set is what I consider to be budget friendly decorating. You get a bundle of 5 items. The quality is okay. They definitely have a mass produced feel to them. I have been decorating with tiered trays for about a year now. This set allows you to get lots of fillers for your tray. Then I would supplement with a few higher end, special pieces. The wooden blocks seem to be printed rather than painted. They're almost a little too perfect. It's a nice variety of holiday decor.

product_metadata.title: 4th of July Tiered Tray Decor - 5 Pcs New Year Wooden Decor Bead Garland & Plush Gnome, Stars and Stripes Wooden Signs Patriotic Decorations for Independence Day Memorial Day Presidents Day
features: ⭐SUPER VALUE PACK - This set includes 5 pcs 4th of July tiered tray decor(Tiered Tray Not Included): 1 pc plush gnome, 3 pcs wooden table signs and 1 pc wooden bead garland.
⭐THEMED DESIGN - All wooden signs are designed with stars and stripes patterns and red, white & blue colors in 3 different shapes- USA, Car & American Flag. ideal for independence day decorations.

⭐PREMIUM MATERIAL - Table signs and bead garland are made of quality wood and linen material, with clear and bright printing, sturdy and serviceable. the American gnome is made of plush and felt, odorless, handmade. It has a strong base and is not easy to tip over.

⭐PERFECT SIZE - The plush gnome is 2.7X8.3in, USA sign is 5.9X2.7in, Car sign is 5.9X3.3 in, American flag sign is 5.9X3.5in, the length of wooden bead garland is 15.7in. Perfect for placing them anywhere, such as home table, shelf, showcase or tiered tray.

⭐POPULAR HOME DECOR - Great design ideas for 4th of july Independence Day, Labor Day, Presidents Day, Memorial Day, Veterans Day, Armed Forces Day, Christmas, New Year and other celebration occasions.
